subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the S85 across all 2 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The S85 appears in exactly two models — the E60/E61 M5 and E63/E64 M6 — making it one of the more focused engines we work on.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Rod bearings and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with VANOS components and throttle actuators inspected and replaced where required.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Rod bearing wear, VANOS pump failure, and throttle actuator failure are all documented patterns for this engine. These are genuine workshop considerations we account for during any S85 rebuild.
